Flat charcoal #303030 background. Featureless solid black humanoid with thin pale outlines separating limbs, hands, legs and weapons. Weapon is physically part of each complete reference silhouette, held naturally. Preserve the reference weapon type and character shape.
Output frames: 1 guard; 2 windup; 3 NEW intermediate between windup and contact; 4 contact; 5 NEW intermediate between contact and follow-through; 6 follow-through; 7 NEW recovery toward the first guard. Three genuine bridge drawings. This is one continuous action moving RIGHT, never a hurt reaction or backwards fall. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs. Same body size, head size and rigid weapon length in every frame. Feet aligned on the same floor at 87% of each cell, stable stance, smooth changes in knees and hips. Keep every weapon and extremity INSIDE its cell with at least 10% margin, use smaller consistent figures if necessary. Connect hands to wrists and grips; straight weapons do not bend. Frame7 must naturally lead into frame1.
Two short daggers. Coil, cross the daggers through the target to the right, uncoil low forward into follow-through, then rise into guard. Never lean backward as if hit. Follow-through is forward crouch with arms opening.
